decisions.what: Generate placeholder PNG/ICO for Tauri icons
decisions.why: Missing icons cause Tauri build failure. Using ImageMagick to create placeholders.

decisions.what: Use raw DOM API in Vite TS template
decisions.why: Context specifically forbids heavy frameworks like React/Vue.
Added rollupOptions to build both index.html (main window) and alert.html (connection alert window).

decisions.what: Mock data rendered in standard browser context
decisions.why: By checking for window.__TAURI__, the app renders the static demo data when visited in a standard browser (like Playwright chromium) to allow for screenshots without the tauri-driver overhead.
Vitest was inadvertently picking up playwright tests; created vitest.config.ts to ignore the tests folder for unit testing.

decisions.what: Inline CSS and script in alert.html
decisions.why: Keeps the alert window self-contained and avoids polluting the main app's CSS, while still supporting dark mode and keyboard navigation.

Added missing package.json fields (description, repository, engines), encapsulated root Promise in main.ts into an IIFE, and removed a magic number float division operation in utils.ts by utilizing exponentiation.
